name: Properties
description: Structured properties for elements of every type: definitions (global or per category, inherited) with more than 30 types such as text, numbers, currency, percent, dates, choices, status, people, links, location, automatic numbers and formulas; free properties; tags as built-in property. Edited with the element, searchable and filterable, shown in the macro “Property report” as table, cards, board, calendar, timeline, charts, key figures or pivot table.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Define global properties
permissions.description: Create, change and remove the definitions of properties that apply everywhere, and in every category.

permissions.label: Define properties
permissions.description: Create, change and remove the definitions of properties of this category (inherited by subcategories) and allow or forbid free properties.

permissions.label: Add free properties
permissions.description: Add properties without a definition (a name and a type) to elements one may edit.
